label: Fires at D2 when a2 rarely reaches S1 right after an unrewarded a2->S1 rare trial.
short_terms: (in_state == 1) * (action == 2) * last_is('a2 S1 u') ;; (in_state == 1) * (action == 2) * last_is('a1 S1 u') ;; (in_state == 1) * (action == 2) * (prev_action == -1)
terms: (in_state == 1) * (action == 2) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (in_state == 1) * (action == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (in_state == 1) * (action == 2) * (prev_action == -1) ;; (in_state == 1) * (action == 2) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * belief_lo ;; (in_state == 1) * (action == 2) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (in_state == 1) * (action == 2) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (in_state == 1) * (action == 2) * (belief_lo < -1) ;; (in_state == 1) * (action == 2) * last_is("a2 S2 u")
explanation: Sparse feature (0.8% of steps), only ever active at D2. Its magnitude is almost entirely a conjunction: this trial a2 led (rarely) to S1, and the previous trial was also a2 -> S1 unrewarded (activation ~0.6-1.4); a smaller boost for a2 -> S1 after any unrewarded trial. Zero at D1/GO and at D2 for all other choice/state combinations. All terms are observed at D2 (in_state and this trial choice are inputs there). The free fit adds modest refinements: weaker when the trial before was unrewarded, stronger when it also reached S1, weaker as belief favours S1, negative after a2 S2 u, and some firing on window-first trials where the previous trial is unknown (an edge effect behind several misses). Short form dev R2 0.56 vs free fit 0.60.

issues: The main claim holds. When a2 reaches S1 right after an a2 S1 u trial, the D2 weight is about 0.64 (dev free fit). That term alone scores test R^2 0.522, against 0.537 for the recorded two-term short form.

The explanation says the feature 'gets a smaller boost when a2 -> S1 follows any unrewarded trial'. That is wrong. I fitted one weight per previous-trial pattern inside the a2->S1 cell: a2 S1 u +0.64, a1 S1 u +0.13, window start (previous trial unknown) +0.10, a2 S2 u -0.011, a1 S2 u ~0, and every rewarded pattern ~0. So the small boost needs an unrewarded trial at S1, not any unrewarded trial.

Because of that, the recorded second term (prev_reward == 0) creates a systematic error. The short form's largest over-prediction is at D2 after a2 S2 u (-0.031). The free fit's 'negative weight after a2 S2 u' only exists to cancel this wrong term.
Swapping the second term for last_is('a1 S1 u') and adding a window-start term (prev_action == -1) removes the a2 S2 u over-prediction in misses. Test R^2 rises to 0.542 (from 0.537); dev is 0.564.

The worst misses that remain are at the window edge. The feature fires 1.3 on the first trial of a window, where the previous trial is unknown, probably because that unseen trial was an a2 S1 u. This is an artefact of the window, not a missing variable.

Belief adds little. Inside the core cell the weight is about 0.66 when belief_lo < -2 and about 0.10 when belief_lo >= 0, but binning belief only raises dev R^2 from about 0.54 to 0.550. Whether the trial before last was rewarded changes the weight only a little (0.56 vs 0.67). Both are small refinements.
